question: The Turkish Defence Ministry has announced that an extensive training flight took place south of Cyprus, involving combat and support aircraft. The Ministry said that the flight was conducted in international airspace and linked it to Türkiye’s determination to protect its rights and interests in the Mediterranean.

In light of the continued Turkish occupation of part of the Republic of Cyprus, the political message of this show of military power raises serious concerns regarding the security of a Member State and regarding regional stability. European solidarity is about actively protecting the sovereignty and sovereign rights of Member States, in this case the Republic of Cyprus.
In view of the above, can the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy answer the following: 1.
How does she view these military activities and threats in relation to the security of the Republic of Cyprus and stability in the Eastern Mediterranean?
What specific diplomatic actions does she intend to take vis-à-vis Ankara to prevent military acts of provocation against Cyprus?

Will she recommend making European funding to Türkiye and the further development of EU-Türkiye relations conditional upon tangible respect for the sovereignty and sovereign rights of the Republic of Cyprus, as was suggested for other countries in a closed meeting of the Committee on Foreign Affairs (AFET)?
